svg.title: Swir Moon Patrol - animated contribution rover
svg.desc: Original pixel-art lunar rover with continuously scrolling mountains, turning wheels, dust and a crater jump. Illuminated ground columns show 53 weekly contribution totals from 2025-09-18 to 2026-09-17. Data snapshot: 2026-09-17 23:05 UTC. Decorative motion is not live gameplay. Reduced-motion preferences stop animation.
svg.text: DATA 2026-09-17 23:05 UTC | BLUE COLUMNS = WEEKLY CONTRIBUTIONS
